intro.text: CorvusDevs ("we", "us", "our") develops and publishes software applications. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle data in Auto Mute Tab for Safari.

p_commitment.text: Auto Mute Tab is designed to work entirely on your device. We do not collect, store, or transmit any personal data.

p_collection.text: Auto Mute Tab does not collect any data. Specifically:

p_thirdparty.text: Auto Mute Tab connects to the following third-party APIs to load emote data:

p_thirdparty2.text: These requests are made directly from your browser to the respective services. We do not proxy, log, or intercept these requests. Please refer to each service's own privacy policy for how they handle requests.

p_account.text: Auto Mute Tab does not access your Twitch account credentials. The extension operates by modifying the Twitch web page in your browser, it does not authenticate with Twitch on your behalf or store any login information.

p_website.text: This website (hosted via GitHub Pages) does not use cookies, analytics, or tracking scripts.

p_children.text: Auto Mute Tab is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect data from children.

p_changes.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The updated version will be posted at this URL with a revised "Last Updated" date.
